amendsWithoutRewriting.survivingCountermodel: Normalize every Inventory row with the required helper, then reject documents where Inventory.Count() > 3 before summing Total.
amendsWithoutRewriting.reason: The dynamic matrix contains one-row controls and one three-row target. Amendment 1 required the helper loop but did not exclude an ancillary row-count rejection or post-helper overwrite.
amendsWithoutRewriting.preProductionAssertion: No production patch, complete native RED, or GREEN exists. Native attempt count remains zero.

businessRuleUnchanged: On every ordinary non-DataExchange.Load SalesInvoice write, every Inventory row is normalized through the existing InventoryTabularSectionClientServer.CalculateAmount calculation path before header Total is summed; this change introduces no new acceptance or rejection rule.

addedCountermodels.wrongRule: Normalize correctly but reject a valid document based on row count or row shape.
Call the helper for every row but overwrite a row/header derived value afterward.
Call the helper correctly but add filtering, sorting, cancellation, rejection, early return, or another branch that changes ordinary-write behavior.

exactBoundedProductionDelta.baseSeam: In the existing normal BeforeWrite path, after the DataExchange.Load early return and immediately before Total = Inventory.Total("Total").
requiredSemanticAddition: One unconditional For Each loop over the complete Inventory tabular section.
The loop body contains exactly one production statement: InventoryTabularSectionClientServer.CalculateAmount(CurrentInventoryRow, VATWithholding).
The existing Total = Inventory.Total("Total") statement remains immediately after the loop.
forbiddenProductionAdditions: Any new condition, branch, rejection, Cancel assignment, exception, assertion, early return, filter, sort, row-count/cardinality check, row deletion/addition, or alternate entry-point behavior.
Any new assignment to Inventory row fields or document fields other than the existing header Total assignment already present in the base file.
Any post-helper overwrite or second calculation path.
Any change to Posting, ManagerModule, metadata, sibling documents, common helper implementation, or DataExchange.Load behavior.
allowedNonSemanticDiff: Indentation and line-ending normalization required to represent the minimal patch.
A concise explanatory comment adjacent to the loop, provided it changes no behavior.
exactBoundedProductionDelta.acceptanceCheck: Review the production diff against the immutable base bytes. After excluding allowed whitespace/comment-only changes, the only added executable behavior must be the unconditional complete-row helper loop described above; existing executable statements must not be removed, reordered, or changed.
exactBoundedProductionDelta.whyNoUnboundedShapeMatrix: The issue authorizes one exact normalization change and no new eligibility rule. Constraining the executable delta closes arbitrary row-count and shape restrictions without pretending a finite set of document sizes proves all cardinalities.

dynamicContractUnchanged.note: All exact stale/normalized draft, posting, exchange, inventory and cost vectors from amendment 1 remain frozen without change.

semanticClosureSelfCheck.question: Which materially plausible wrong implementation can still pass the dynamic matrix and exact bounded production-delta criterion?
semanticClosureSelfCheck.answer: No retained countermodel survives. The dynamic matrix distinguishes row/field/order effects and existing side effects; the exact executable-delta criterion excludes added cardinality or shape rejection, post-helper overwrite, filtering, alternate control flow, and stock-bypass logic.
residualUnknownsUnchanged: DataExchange.Load, VATWithholding=true/tax-exemption combinations, UI manual amount editing, advance clearing, EDI, undo/reposting/imports, SupplierInvoice and other documents remain outside scope.
Native RED can invalidate a frozen prediction; any mismatch requires stop and a transparent amendment before production patch.

reviewGate.reviewTarget: Exact commit/tree containing the original contract and both transparent amendments, with no production patch.
reviewGate.challenge: Try to construct a materially wrong implementation that passes the unchanged dynamic observations and also obeys the exact bounded executable-delta criterion.
